title: HSK 3.13 · 生存, 保存, 现象, 形象, 费用
focus: 经营 · 困 · 初 · 通常 · 浪费 · 香 · 反正 · 内心 · 费 · 防 · 舞台 · 现金 · 糖 · 阳光 · 优势 · 科技 · 印象 · 烟 · 生意 · 存 · 形象 · 生产 · 适应 · 费用 · 生存 · 现象 · 形式 · 现代 · 伤心 · 当初 · 保留 · 卫生 · 保安 · 国内 · 防止 · 采用 · 应当 · 主意 · 安装 · 保存
body:
Business and daily-life words. 生 *life, produce*, 保 *keep*, 现 *appear, now*, 象 *image*, 费 *spend* and 存 *store* each come back two or more times, and 当 returns from earlier lessons in 当初 and 应当.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 生 | shēng | life, produce | 生意, 生产, 生存, 卫生 |
| 保 | bǎo | protect, keep | 保留, 保安, 保存 |
| 现 | xiàn | appear; now (王 jade + 见 see) | 现金, 现象, 现代 |
| 象 | xiàng | elephant; image | 印象, 形象, 现象 |
| 费 | fèi | spend, fee (贝 money) | 浪费, 费, 费用 |
| 存 | cún | keep, store | 存, 生存, 保存 |
| 心 | xīn | heart | 内心, 伤心 |
| 防 | fáng | guard (阝 mound) | 防, 防止 |

## Watch out

- 象 (image, elephant) vs 像 (亻, resemble): 印象, 现象, 形象 all use 象 without 亻.
- 主意 (idea) is zhǔyi with neutral tone; 生意 (business) is shēngyi.
- 内 (nèi, inside) vs 肉 (ròu, meat): 肉 has two 人 inside.

cards.Example: 他经营一家饭馆。 tā jīngyíng yì jiā fànguǎn: He runs a restaurant
cards.Notes: 经 manage, pass through (纟 thread) + 营 camp, operate = manage operations

cards.Example: 我好困啊。 wǒ hǎo kùn a: I'm so sleepy
cards.Notes: 囗 enclosure + 木 tree = a tree boxed in, trapped. Lookalike: 因 yīn, 困 has 木

cards.Example: 我是初学者。 wǒ shì chūxuézhě: I'm a beginner
cards.Notes: 衤 clothing + 刀 knife = cutting cloth, the first step of making clothes

cards.Example: 我通常七点起床。 wǒ tōngcháng qī diǎn qǐchuáng: I usually get up at seven
cards.Notes: 通 go through + 常 often = generally, usually

cards.Example: 别浪费时间。 bié làngfèi shíjiān: Don't waste time
cards.Notes: 浪 wave (氵 water + 良 liáng sound) + 费 spend = spend recklessly, waste

cards.Example: 这个菜好香！ zhège cài hǎo xiāng: This dish smells great!
cards.Notes: 禾 grain + 日 (originally 甘 sweet) = sweet-smelling grain, fragrant

cards.Example: 反正我不去。 fǎnzhèng wǒ bú qù: I'm not going anyway
cards.Notes: 反 reverse + 正 right side = whether flipped or upright, anyway

cards.Example: 我内心很高兴。 wǒ nèixīn hěn gāoxìng: Deep down I'm happy
cards.Notes: 内 inside + 心 heart = the heart within

cards.Example: 这很费时间。 zhè hěn fèi shíjiān: This takes a lot of time
cards.Notes: 贝 shell, money + 弗 fú for the sound = spend money

cards.Example: 要防小偷。 yào fáng xiǎotōu: Watch out for thieves
cards.Notes: 阝 mound, embankment + 方 fāng for the sound = dike, defend

cards.Example: 她站在舞台上。 tā zhàn zài wǔtái shang: She's standing on stage
cards.Notes: 舞 dance + 台 platform = dance platform, stage

cards.Example: 你带现金了吗？ nǐ dài xiànjīn le ma: Did you bring cash?
cards.Notes: 现 present, on hand + 金 gold, money = money on hand

cards.Example: 孩子喜欢吃糖。 háizi xǐhuan chī táng: Kids love sweets
cards.Notes: 米 rice, grain + 唐 táng for the sound

cards.Example: 今天阳光很好。 jīntiān yángguāng hěn hǎo: It's sunny today
cards.Notes: 阳 sun (阝 + 日 sun) + 光 light = sunlight

cards.Example: 这是我们的优势。 zhè shì wǒmen de yōushì: This is our advantage
cards.Notes: 优 excellent (亻 + 尤 yóu sound) + 势 power, position = superior position

cards.Example: 科技发展很快。 kējì fāzhǎn hěn kuài: Tech develops fast
cards.Notes: 科 science, subject + 技 skill (扌 hand + 支 zhī sound) = science and skill

cards.Example: 我对他印象很好。 wǒ duì tā yìnxiàng hěn hǎo: I have a good impression of him
cards.Notes: 印 stamp, print + 象 image = the image stamped on you

cards.Example: 这里不能抽烟。 zhèli bù néng chōuyān: No smoking here
cards.Notes: 火 fire + 因 yīn for the sound = smoke

cards.Example: 最近生意很好。 zuìjìn shēngyi hěn hǎo: Business is good lately
cards.Notes: 生 life, livelihood + 意 intent = making a living; neutral yi in speech

cards.Example: 我去银行存钱。 wǒ qù yínháng cún qián: I'm going to deposit money
cards.Notes: 子 child + 才 cái (phonetic, top-left) = keep alive, preserve. Lookalike: 在 zài

cards.Example: 他的形象很好。 tā de xíngxiàng hěn hǎo: He has a good image
cards.Notes: 形 shape (彡 strokes) + 象 image = outward image

cards.Example: 这里生产汽车。 zhèli shēngchǎn qìchē: They make cars here
cards.Notes: 生 give birth, produce + 产 produce = produce

cards.Example: 我已经适应了。 wǒ yǐjīng shìyìng le: I've adapted already
cards.Notes: 适 suit (辶 walk + 舌 shé) + 应 respond = suit and respond, adapt

cards.Example: 费用是多少？ fèiyòng shì duōshao: How much does it cost?
cards.Notes: 费 spend + 用 use = money used, cost

cards.Example: 人要喝水才能生存。 rén yào hē shuǐ cái néng shēngcún: People need water to survive
cards.Notes: 生 live + 存 keep, exist = stay alive

cards.Example: 这是很常见的现象。 zhè shì hěn chángjiàn de xiànxiàng: This is a common phenomenon
cards.Notes: 现 appear + 象 image = what appears, a phenomenon

cards.Example: 形式不重要。 xíngshì bú zhòngyào: The form doesn't matter
cards.Notes: 形 shape + 式 pattern, style (弋 + 工) = shape and style, form

cards.Example: 这是现代艺术。 zhè shì xiàndài yìshù: This is modern art
cards.Notes: 现 now + 代 era, generation = the present era, modern

cards.Example: 别伤心了。 bié shāngxīn le: Don't be sad
cards.Notes: 伤 hurt (亻 person) + 心 heart = hurt heart

cards.Example: 当初我不知道。 dāngchū wǒ bù zhīdào: At the time I didn't know
cards.Notes: 当 at that + 初 beginning = at the start, back then

cards.Example: 这张照片我要保留。 zhè zhāng zhàopiàn wǒ yào bǎoliú: I'll keep this photo
cards.Notes: 保 keep (亻 + 呆) + 留 stay = keep it staying

cards.Example: 这里很卫生。 zhèli hěn wèishēng: It's very clean here
cards.Notes: 卫 guard + 生 life = guarding life, hygiene. Also 卫生间 bathroom

cards.Example: 门口有保安。 ménkǒu yǒu bǎo'ān: There's a guard at the door
cards.Notes: 保 protect + 安 safe (宀 roof + 女) = keep safe, security

cards.Example: 他在国内上大学。 tā zài guónèi shàng dàxué: He goes to university at home
cards.Notes: 国 country + 内 inside = inside the country

cards.Example: 多洗手，防止感冒。 duō xǐ shǒu, fángzhǐ gǎnmào: Wash hands to prevent colds
cards.Notes: 防 guard + 止 stop = guard and stop, prevent

cards.Example: 我们采用新方法。 wǒmen cǎiyòng xīn fāngfǎ: We're adopting a new method
cards.Notes: 采 pick + 用 use = pick and use

cards.Example: 你应当早点儿来。 nǐ yīngdāng zǎo diǎnr lái: You should come earlier
cards.Notes: 应 should + 当 ought = should

cards.Example: 这是个好主意！ zhè shì ge hǎo zhǔyi: That's a good idea!
cards.Notes: 主 main + 意 intention = the main intention, a plan. Neutral yi

cards.Example: 我在安装软件。 wǒ zài ānzhuāng ruǎnjiàn: I'm installing software
cards.Notes: 安 settle, place + 装 fit, load (衣 clothing + 壮 zhuàng sound) = put in place

cards.Example: 别忘了保存文件。 bié wàng le bǎocún wénjiàn: Don't forget to save the file
cards.Notes: 保 keep + 存 store = keep stored, save
